region_l1.format: ISO 3166-2 first-level subdivision codes of the profile's country, plus unknown
region_l1.description: First-level region (state, province, emirate, region). Banks: the account's home branch, or the customer's domicile if the profile declares `region_basis: customer_domicile` (required for institutions without branches). Customer-level metrics such as digital_transactions use the customer's region on the same basis. Insurers: the risk location (each insured location, the vehicle's registered addres

region_l2.format: ISO 3166-2 second-level codes where the standard has them (e.g. LK-11), otherwise institution_defined and mapped at onboarding to the national statistics office's code, plus unknown
region_l2.description: Second-level region (district, county, department, municipality). Every value names its region_l1 parent. Same basis as region_l1.

corridor.description: The other country in a cross-border flow: the sending country for inward remittances, the receiving country for outward ones, the foreign origin or destination for trade and cargo. Taken from the payment or shipment record, not the customer.

destination_region.format: UN M49 sub-region codes (e.g. 145 Western Asia, 035 South-eastern Asia, 154 Northern Europe), plus unknown
destination_region.description: Where a trip goes (travel insurance). The first destination outside the home country named on the policy.

currency.description: The original currency of the transaction, account or contract.

segment.description: One value per customer, the first rule that applies, in this order. Individuals: remittance_linked (≥1 inward personal remittance credited to any of the customer's accounts in the 6 months before the segment date); pensioner (≥1 pension credit in the 3 months before); student (holds a student product at the segment date; a declared occupation alone doesn't count); salaried (a salary credit, by pay

age_band.description: Age of the individual customer (the primary holder) at the segment date.

size_band.description: Business size, first rule that applies: startup (incorporated less than 3 years before the segment date), then micro, sme or corporate by the institution's declared size rule (turnover, employees or exposure). Examples of local rules: the EU SME definition (fewer than 250 staff), India's MSME bands, a central bank's SME lending definition.

sector.format: ISIC Rev.4 sections A-U, plus unknown
sector.description: The business customer's main economic activity at the segment date.

sector_l2.format: ISIC Rev.4 divisions (2 digits, 01-99); each names its section as parent, plus unknown
sector_l2.description: The same activity at division level, so a shock to one industry (garments = 14, tourism accommodation = 55) can be separated from its section.

employer_sector.format: ISIC Rev.4 sections A-U, plus unknown, plus unknown
employer_sector.description: ISIC section of the employer that paid the individual's most recent salary credit before the segment date (public administration is section O).

merchant_sector.format: ISIC Rev.4 sections A-U, plus unknown
merchant_sector.description: The merchant's activity, for card spend and acquiring.

channel.description: The service channel where the transaction or application was made. `api` covers host-to-host and open-banking access; `agent` covers banking agents and correspondents.

sales_channel.description: How an insurance policy (or a bank-distributed policy) was sold. `partner` covers affinity, retail, telecom and employer schemes; `direct` is the insurer's own staff and branches; `digital` its own web and app sales.

vehicle_type.description: Class of the financed or insured vehicle.

new_used.description: Whether the vehicle was new (first registration) when financed or first insured.

claim_type.description: What the claim is for; the value set depends on the category. A motor flood claim is claim_type=natural_peril with peril=flood.

peril.description: The cause of loss. `storm` covers wind, cyclone, hurricane and typhoon.

settlement_mode.description: Health claims: billed directly by the provider (cashless) or claimed back by the insured.

traveller_type.description: Purpose of travel as recorded on the policy.

tenor_band.description: Contractual tenor at placement or booking.

rate_type.description: Whether the interest or profit rate is fixed for the life of the contract, resets with a reference rate, or is fixed for an initial period and then resets.

lc_type.description: Letter of credit payable at sight or deferred (usance, acceptance, deferred payment).

terms.description: Import payment terms outside letters of credit: documentary collection (D/P, D/A), open account, or payment in advance.

withdrawal_reason.description: Reason recorded for an early retirement-plan withdrawal.

restructure_reason.description: Reason recorded on a restructure request.

asset_class.description: Main asset class of an investment product or fund.

outflow_type.description: Term-deposit outflow at maturity, or a premature withdrawal (a broken deposit).

action.description: Write-off, or restructure because of financial difficulty.

spend_location.description: Card spend at a merchant in the profile's country or abroad (including foreign e-commerce).

card_origin.description: Acquiring: whether the card was issued in the profile's country or abroad.

payout_method.description: How an inward remittance was paid to the beneficiary.

source.description: Where the foreign currency a customer sells to the institution comes from.

insurance_line.description: Line of an insurance policy distributed by a bank.

policy_duration_band.description: Policy year at the event date, counted from issue.

cause_group.description: Cause of death as notified on the claim.

collection_method.description: How a premium instalment is collected.

trade_direction.description: Direction of an insured shipment relative to the profile's country.

commodity_group.format: Harmonized System sections I-XXI, plus unknown

scheme.description: Whether the premium is subsidised under a public scheme.

savings.name: Deposit inflow
savings.question: Is money coming into these accounts faster or slower than normal for this time of year?

savings.name: Withdrawals
savings.question: Are customers taking money out faster than normal?

savings.name: Deposit balance
savings.question: How large is the book, and is a foreign-currency balance draining?

savings.name: Inward remittance credits
savings.question: Are remittances into these accounts falling, judged in the currency they were sent in?

savings.name: Large-depositor net flow
savings.question: Are the biggest depositors moving money out?

savings.name: Term-deposit placements
savings.question: Are customers placing more or less new money in term deposits (for example before a tax or rate change)?

savings.name: Term-deposit non-renewal outflow
savings.question: Are maturing term deposits leaving instead of being renewed, or being broken early?

savings.name: New accounts
savings.question: Are customers opening fewer accounts than normal for the season?

savings.name: Customer-initiated closures
savings.question: Are customers closing accounts faster than normal?

savings.name: Offered rate
savings.question: What rate are we offering, so the checks can compare it with rivals' public rates?

wealth.name: Retirement contributions
wealth.question: Are members paying in less than normal?

wealth.name: Early withdrawals
wealth.question: Are members withdrawing savings before retirement, from hardship or emigration?

wealth.name: Investment subscriptions
wealth.question: Are customers buying fewer investment products?

wealth.name: Investment redemptions
wealth.question: Are customers selling out of investment products early?

wealth.name: 20-day fund return
wealth.question: Has the fund lost value in the last 20 business days to a date?

wealth.name: 20-day return vs benchmark
wealth.question: Is the fund doing worse than its benchmark?

gold_loan.name: New pledges
gold_loan.question: Are more households (or fewer) pledging gold for cash?

gold_loan.name: Renewals
gold_loan.question: How many loans were rolled over at maturity?

gold_loan.name: Top-ups
gold_loan.question: How many borrowers drew more on existing pledges?

gold_loan.name: Redemptions
gold_loan.question: Are fewer borrowers redeeming their gold?

gold_loan.name: Loans above the LTV limit
gold_loan.question: How much of the book is now under-collateralised after a gold-price fall?

gold_loan.name: Overdue gold loans
gold_loan.question: Are more loans past maturity without being renewed or redeemed?

gold_loan.name: Auctions
gold_loan.question: Are more pledges going to auction?

gold_loan.name: Offered rate
gold_loan.question: What rate are we offering, so the checks can compare it with rivals' public rates?

retail_loan.name: Instalment collection rate
retail_loan.question: Are borrowers paying this period's instalments on time (the earliest sign of stress)?

retail_loan.name: Roll rate to 30+ dpd
retail_loan.question: Is more of the performing book falling 30 days behind each month?

retail_loan.name: 30+ days past due
retail_loan.question: What share of the book is 30 or more days past due?

retail_loan.name: Write-offs and restructures
retail_loan.question: How much was written off or restructured this month (explains dpd moves)?

retail_loan.name: Restructure requests
retail_loan.question: Are more borrowers asking to reschedule?

retail_loan.name: Moratorium enrolment
retail_loan.question: How much of the book is under a payment moratorium or relief deferral?

retail_loan.name: Loan applications
retail_loan.question: Is demand for credit rising or falling?

retail_loan.name: Approval rate
retail_loan.question: Is the institution approving a smaller share of applications?

retail_loan.name: Prepayments
retail_loan.question: Are borrowers paying off early, perhaps to refinance with a rival?

retail_loan.name: Credit-line utilisation
retail_loan.question: Are households drawing more of their overdrafts and credit lines?

vehicle_finance.name: Instalment collection rate
vehicle_finance.question: Are borrowers paying this period's instalments on time?

vehicle_finance.name: Roll rate to 30+ dpd
vehicle_finance.question: Is more of the performing book falling 30 days behind?

vehicle_finance.name: Repossessions
vehicle_finance.question: How many vehicles were repossessed (explains dpd)?

vehicle_finance.name: Moratorium enrolment
vehicle_finance.question: How much of the book is under a moratorium?

cards.name: Domestic card spend
cards.question: Are cardholders spending less at home?

cards.name: Cross-border card spend
cards.question: Are cardholders spending less abroad, judged in the currencies they spend in?

cards.name: Card payment rate
cards.question: Are cardholders paying less of their statements?

cards.name: Revolving share
cards.question: Are more cardholders carrying balances past the due date?

cards.name: Roll rate to 30+ dpd
cards.question: Is more of the performing card book falling 30 days behind?

cards.name: Card fraud rate
cards.question: Is card fraud rising (a data breach at us, a rival or a merchant)?

cards.name: Write-offs and restructures
cards.question: How much was written off or restructured (explains dpd)?

cards.name: Moratorium enrolment
cards.question: How much of the card book is under a payment holiday?

business_loan.name: Facility utilisation
business_loan.question: Are businesses drawing more of their working-capital lines (cash-flow strain)?

business_loan.name: Instalment collection rate
business_loan.question: Are businesses paying this period's instalments on time?

business_loan.name: Roll rate to 30+ dpd
business_loan.question: Is more of the performing business book falling 30 days behind?

business_loan.name: 30+ days past due
business_loan.question: What share of the business book is 30+ days past due?

business_loan.name: Returned cheque and direct-debit rate
business_loan.question: Are more business payments bouncing for lack of funds?

business_loan.name: Restructure requests
business_loan.question: Are more businesses asking to reschedule?

business_loan.name: Moratorium enrolment
business_loan.question: How much of the business book is under a moratorium?

business_loan.name: Business credit applications
business_loan.question: Is business demand for credit changing?

business_loan.name: Exposure
business_loan.question: How concentrated is the book in a shocked sector?

agri_loan.name: Agricultural disbursements
agri_loan.question: Are farmers borrowing less for the season (prices, a drought, a policy change)?

agri_loan.name: Instalment collection rate
agri_loan.question: Are farmers repaying what falls due after harvest?

agri_loan.name: Roll rate past 30 dpd
agri_loan.question: Is more of the performing farm book falling more than 30 days behind?

agri_loan.name: Restructure requests
agri_loan.question: Are more farmers asking to reschedule after a bad season?

agri_loan.name: Moratorium enrolment
agri_loan.question: How much of the farm book is under relief?

trade_finance.name: Letters of credit opened
trade_finance.question: Are importers opening fewer letters of credit?

trade_finance.name: Import payments outside LCs
trade_finance.question: Are importers paying for fewer shipments on collection, open-account or advance terms?

trade_finance.name: Export receipts
trade_finance.question: Are exporters receiving less (or more) for their shipments, in the currency they invoice in?

trade_finance.name: Trade-finance outstanding
trade_finance.question: How large is the funded trade book?

payments.name: Digital and self-service transactions
payments.question: Are customers transacting less through digital channels (for example in a disaster area)?

payments.name: Own-system failure rate
payments.question: Are our own systems failing more transactions (an outage or a trust problem)?

payments.name: Active digital users
payments.question: Are fewer customers using our app and internet banking (lost to a rival or after an incident)?

payments.name: Cash withdrawals
payments.question: Are customers pulling cash (a trust scare, a disaster, a payment outage)?

payments.name: Merchant acquiring volume
payments.question: Are our merchants selling less (local spending, tourism)?

remittances.name: Inward remittances
remittances.question: Is our remittance business receiving less from a corridor, in the currency sent?

remittances.name: Outward remittances
remittances.question: Are customers sending less abroad (fees lost) or much more (capital flight)?

fx.name: Customer FX purchases
fx.question: Are customers buying more foreign currency (pressure on our FX position) or less (lost business)?

fx.name: Customer FX sales
fx.question: Are customers converting more foreign currency into the base currency (e.g. under a conversion rule)?

distribution.name: Bancassurance new premium
distribution.question: Are we selling less insurance for our partners (after a partner switch, a rule change or a squeeze on households)?

life.name: Premium collection rate
life.question: Are policyholders paying fewer premiums when due (1-2 months before lapses show)?

life.name: New policies
life.question: Are we selling fewer new policies?

life.name: New business premium
life.question: Is the value of new business falling?

life.name: Lapse rate
life.question: Are more policies lapsing for non-payment?

life.name: Surrenders
life.question: Are policyholders cashing in savings policies (rates up elsewhere, or need for cash)?

life.name: Death claims
life.question: Are more death claims coming in (an epidemic, a disaster)?

life.name: New-money yield vs guarantee
life.question: Is the yield on new investments falling below what in-force policies guarantee?

health.name: Claims per 1,000 insured
health.question: Are more claims coming in (an epidemic, a flood)?

health.name: Procedure cost index
health.question: Is the cost of common treatments and drugs rising?

health.name: Median claim cost
health.question: What does a typical claim cost now (context)?

health.name: New policies
health.question: Are we selling fewer new policies?

motor.name: Claims per 1,000 vehicles
motor.question: Are more motor claims coming in (a flood, more traffic)?

motor.name: Median claim cost
motor.question: What does a typical own-damage claim cost now (context)?

motor.name: New policies
motor.question: Are we insuring fewer new vehicles (import rules, prices)?

motor.name: Renewal rate
motor.question: Are fewer vehicle owners renewing with us?

travel.name: New policies
travel.question: Are fewer people buying travel cover (a weaker currency, trouble at a destination)?

travel.name: Claims per 1,000 trips
travel.question: Are more travellers claiming after trouble abroad?

travel.name: Median claim cost (original currency)
travel.question: What does a typical claim abroad cost, in the currency it is paid in (context)?

property.name: Claims per 1,000 insured locations
property.question: Did a disaster drive up claims where we insure?

property.name: Median claim cost
property.question: What does a typical claim cost (context for rebuild costs)?

property.name: Sum insured
property.question: How much do we insure in the affected area?

property.name: New policies
property.question: Are we writing fewer new property policies?

marine.name: Insured shipments
marine.question: Are our cargo clients shipping less (tariffs, a weaker currency, a port closure)?

liability.name: New policies
liability.question: Are businesses buying less liability cover?

agriculture.name: New policies (enrolments)
agriculture.question: Are fewer farmers insuring this season?

agriculture.name: Sum insured
agriculture.question: How much crop and livestock value do we cover where a disaster hit?

agriculture.name: Claims per 1,000 policies
agriculture.question: Did drought, flood or pests trigger more claims or index payouts?

micro_insurance.name: New policies
micro_insurance.question: Are fewer low-income households taking cover?

micro_insurance.name: Premium collection rate
micro_insurance.question: Are households missing small premium payments (an early stress signal)?

micro_insurance.name: Claims per 1,000 insured
micro_insurance.question: Are more claims coming in (an epidemic, a disaster)?

insurer_company.name: Solvency ratio (published)
insurer_company.question: Where does published capital stand (context for investment shocks)?

insurer_company.name: Reinsurance cost
insurer_company.question: How much do we pay for reinsurance, in the currencies it is priced in?

themes.fx: exchange-rate moves of the base currency
themes.rates: policy, market or administered interest/profit-rate changes
themes.prices: consumer, fuel, food, energy or utility price changes
themes.commodities: commodity prices that act on a product directly: gold, crops, oil as cargo
themes.regulation: taxes, central-bank or supervisor directions, relief schemes, import controls, tariffs
themes.competitor: a rival's pricing, new product, failure or partner switch
themes.macro: growth, employment, recession or recovery news
themes.sector: a shock or boost to one economic sector
themes.disaster: natural or man-made disasters and epidemics, at home or abroad
themes.trust: news that could shake confidence in this institution, a rival or the system
